d:
Chhathi maiya ki jay! jay chhathi maiya!
Chhath mahaparv ke pavan avsar par sunie chhathi maiya aur sury dev ki aaradhna se saja chhath puja git | is bhaktimay git men chhath vrat ki shraddha aur chhathi maiya ke prati atut vishvas ki jhalak milti hai.
Chhath Pooja Geet: Chhathi Maiya Asra Tohar
